turns.learner: Hi! Can we learn a and an today?
turns.tutor:
Yes! We use "a" before a consonant sound and "an" before a vowel sound.

Here is a model. I say the next word: "egg". It starts with the sound "eh", a vowel sound. So: "an egg".

Now you try:

Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
